scoring_justification: The analytical model is fully described; the hidden checker re-implements the iterative thermoelectric model to recompute efficiency, power, current, and work ratios from the agent's reported parameter combinations, comparing with tolerances.

outputs.description: Device efficiency for every combination of temperature ratio, load resistance ratio, and geometric parameter.
Output power for every combination of temperature ratio, load resistance ratio, and geometric parameter.
Output current for every combination of temperature ratio, load resistance ratio, and geometric parameter.
Work ratios for material-1 and material-2 over the parameter grid; checked for trend consistency (peak location, sign, monotonicity).

output_contract.notes: The analytical model uses temperature-dependent material properties from Table 1 of the paper. No external datasets are required. The solver must implement the closed-form expressions for effective Seebeck coefficients, resistances, thermal conductance, and efficiency/power/current/work ratios as derived in the paper.

steps.description: Recompute efficiency from analytical model; fraction of rows within 5% relative tolerance.
Recompute output power; fraction of rows within 10% relative tolerance.
Recompute output current; fraction of rows within 10% relative tolerance.
Recompute work ratios xi1, xi2 from unsegmented and segmented power; fraction of rows within 5% relative tolerance.
